gen-gf-baloo-tamma-2-satoshi: Satoshi reads tall and friendly, every stroke cut to a single width with an e that stays open. Baloo Tamma 2 then takes the heading with big counters and a commanding, distinctive lowercase, and long paragraphs would still flow smoothly.
gen-gf-baloo-tamma-2-switzer: Approachable first: Switzer draws wire-like letters with a tall waist line. Baloo Tamma 2 shouts above it with big-countered, commanding lowercase, while paragraphs of Switzer would run on without any thick-and-thin wobble to snag the eye.
gen-gf-baloo-tamma-2-work-sans: Baloo Tamma 2 leads with big counters and a tall, commanding lowercase that never snags. Work Sans follows in thin, uniform outlines with a high mean line, so the two split the page cleanly.
gen-gf-baloo-tammudu-2-archivo: Editorial in spirit, Archivo opens its curves outward and carries a commanding x-height under a rounded, tall Baloo Tammudu 2 heading. Each font keeps its own job on the page.
gen-gf-baloo-tammudu-2-fs-asap: Asap reads openly, its c forms drawn as generous arcs. Baloo Tammudu 2 is the one to make a bold statement, while Asap's body height, nearly matching its capitals, keeps running text steady.
gen-gf-baloo-tammudu-2-fs-be-vietnam-pro: Be Vietnam Pro reads clean, with strokes like a bent steel rod and curve endings that stay well apart. Baloo Tammudu 2 brings the rounded punch above it.
gen-gf-baloo-tammudu-2-fs-fira-sans: Rounded, tall lowercase with an e that opens up marks Baloo Tammudu 2. Fira Sans answers with a larger x-height and no thick and thin contrast, so the heading's roundness stands out against it.
gen-gf-baloo-tammudu-2-fs-merriweather-s: Merriweather Sans makes words look sturdy and large, with an e whose eye opens clearly to the right. Baloo Tammudu 2 earns its keep big and short, where its tall rounded lowercase can command attention.
gen-gf-baloo-tammudu-2-fs-public-sans: Public Sans brings a hefty lowercase and broad counters. Baloo Tammudu 2 does its best work as a distinctive, commanding heading with rounded forms, while Public Sans handles the steady job of carrying the text.
gen-gf-baloo-tammudu-2-fs-ranade: Round, loud and friendly up top. Ranade below has a weight that shifts only slightly, with stroke ends set far apart, so long paragraphs would feel spread out and organic.
